historical_references.reference: Jai Singh I (1621-1674) was a Rajput king who ruled the Amber state in Rajasthan and expanded his territory by defeating the Mughals in several battles. He assumed the title 'Jai Singh' after a successful victory over the Mughal emperor Jehangir in 1623.

Jai Singh II (1688-1743) was the son of Jai Singh I and is best known for founding the city of Jaipur in 1727, which served as the capital of the Amber State. He was an accomplished astronomer and is believed to have commissioned the construction of the Jantar Mantar observatory in Jaipur.
